tasks.subject: Lots Task 1: DB schema — inventory_lot + delivery_receipt_line columns
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add lot_number and expiry_date to delivery_receipt_line; create inventory_lot table.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/lot_tracking.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] delivery_receipt_line has nullable lot_number and expiry_date columns
- [ ] inventory_lot table exists with all columns
- [ ] RLS enabled with current_tenant_id() policy
- [ ] Unique constraint on (tenant_id, component_id, lot_number)

**Verify:** Run patch → information_schema.columns shows lot_number and expiry_date on delivery_receipt_line.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/lot_tracking.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase sql editor", "acceptanceCriteria": ["lot_number column exists", "expiry_date column exists", "inventory_lot table exists", "unique constraint on lot number"]}
```

tasks.subject: Lots Task 2: Lot lib — createLots and getLotsByComponent
tasks.description:
**Goal:** createLots (upsert, ignores duplicates) and getLotsByComponent (ordered by expiry ASC nulls last).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/inventory/lots.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] createLots skips lines with empty lot_number
- [ ] createLots uses upsert with ignoreDuplicates=true
- [ ] getLotsByComponent orders by expiry_date ASC nulls last

**Verify:** Call from app → insert lot → fetch it back.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/inventory/lots.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["createLots inserts lots", "createLots is idempotent", "getLotsByComponent returns ordered lots"]}
```

tasks.subject: Lots Task 3: Update goods-inwards action — accept and persist lot data
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extend DeliveryReceiptLineInput with lot fields and create inventory_lot records after the RPC.

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] DeliveryReceiptLineInput has lot_number and expiry_date fields
- [ ] createLots called after receive_delivery_receipt RPC succeeds
- [ ] Lot creation failure is non-fatal
- [ ] activity_log metadata includes lots_count

**Verify:** Create delivery receipt with lot number → Supabase inventory_lot has new row.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["DeliveryReceiptLineInput has lot fields", "inventory_lot rows created", "lot failure non-fatal"]}
```

tasks.subject: Lots Task 4: Update goods-inwards new receipt UI — lot and expiry fields
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add optional lot number and expiry date inputs to each receipt line in the new delivery receipt form.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/new/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each line row has a lot number text input (optional)
- [ ] Expiry date input only shown when lot number is filled
- [ ] lot_number and expiry_date included in submitted JSON
- [ ] Empty lot_number submits as null

**Verify:** npm run dev → Goods Inwards → New Receipt → lot fields visible → submit → inventory_lot row created.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/goods-inwards/new/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["lot number input on each line", "expiry date conditional on lot number", "fields in form submission"]}
```

tasks.subject: Lots Task 5: Component lots view — lot balance tab
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Show all lots held for a component on its detail page, ordered by expiry, with warning for lots expiring ≤30 days.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/lots-tab.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Lots section shows lot number, qty received, expiry date, received date
- [ ] Lots expiring ≤30 days use var(--warning) colour
- [ ] Empty state when no lots exist

**Verify:** npm run dev → Components → component with lots → Lots section shows correct data.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/[componentId]/lots-tab.tsx", "src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["lots tab shows lot data", "expiry warning colour applied", "empty state shown"]}
```
